fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects executions of scripts located in potentially suspicious locations such as "/tmp" via a shell such as "bash", "sh", etc.
fields.name: Execution Of Script Located In Potentially Suspicious Directory
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "/bash" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/csh" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/dash" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/fish" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/ksh" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/sh" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/zsh") and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -c " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/tmp/"))
